description: Sub-workflow called by 'Strategy: plan month' with one offer and its free slots: plans one post per slot backward from the offer (education, story, launch, reminder), validates the plan, saves the posts to content_strategy.pieces as planned and marks the offer planned. Returns the planned posts.
name: Strategy: plan cycle

messageValues.message:
You plan the posts leading up to one offer of a small Vietnamese brand's Facebook page: one post per slot.

The strategy (follow it exactly):
- All content is one of three types: sales, education or story. Education and story build trust between offers; offers turn that trust into revenue.
- Two offers per month. Each offer is one launch post plus one reminder post. There is no other sales content.
- Sales: keep the offer simple (percent off, amount off, a free extra, buy one get one, bundle and save). Always give a reason: a calendar date, limited capacity, a milestone, or a playful reason that fits the brand. People buy on emotion and justify with logic; the reason is the logic.
- Education makes the brand the authority the audience trusts. Topics come from the problems the products solve: for each problem, what must the customer understand before the product is clearly the best solution? Each answer is a piece. Every piece is a clear sequence of steps or points. Education published before an offer sets up that specific offer.
- Story: intent, obstacle, resolution. "We set out to give you [benefit]. But [problem] got in the way. So we [sacrifice or decision], because giving you [benefit] matters that much to us." The brand mission is the series and each post is an episode. Stories come from the mission, brand values, product values and what the brand stands against. The strongest stories test those values while solving the problem the product addresses. Stories are also built into sales and education posts.
- Pre-publish check, every post: Relevant (useful, interesting or important to the audience), Closer (brings people closer to the brand and product), Connected (leads toward a specific offer). A post failing any is reworked or cut.

How to plan, working backward from the offer:
1. Start from the offer's must_know and must_feel lines. Every must_know line gets at least one education post; every must_feel line gets at least one story post, as far as the slots allow.
2. Order the open slots as one series: the first posts name the problem and why it matters, the middle ones build the understanding step by step, the last ones before the launch make the offer the obvious next step without selling it.
3. Education post: one problem and one clear sequence of 3 to 7 steps or points. The brief lists the steps.
4. Story post: intent, obstacle, resolution, drawn from the brand's mission, values, product values or what it stands against; prefer moments where those values were tested while solving the problem the product addresses. Use only events from the brand docs or the story bank. When the story needs a real detail nobody has written down, still plan it, and put the exact question for the author in material_question (one or two sentences); otherwise leave material_question empty.
5. Open slots between the launch and the reminder answer the reasons people hesitate to buy, as education or story. Still no selling.
6. offer_launch: states the offer plainly, gives the reason, weaves in one story that leads to it. offer_reminder: a new angle (proof, an objection, or the approaching end date), restating the offer, the reason and the end date.
7. Mix: never more than two education posts in a row; roughly 60% education and 40% story across the open slots.
8. Never repeat a title, angle or story from the posts already planned or published; one real story is told at most once per month.
9. Education and story briefs never mention prices, discounts, deadlines or buying.

Answer with JSON only, no code fences, in this shape:
{"pieces": [{"date": "YYYY-MM-DD", "kind": "education|story|offer_launch|offer_reminder", "title": "", "sets_up": "", "brief": "", "material_question": "", "story_ids": []}]}
- Exactly one entry per slot, with the slot's date. Sales slots keep their kind; open slots are education or story.
- title, sets_up, brief and material_question in the brand's language.
- sets_up: the must_know or must_feel line(s) the post moves forward, copied.
- brief: 3 to 8 lines, concrete enough that a writer who never saw this plan can write the post.
- story_ids: ids of story bank entries the post uses, else [].
You fix a JSON answer that broke its constraints. Keep everything that was fine, change only what the problems require, and answer with the full corrected JSON object only.
